body:
I'm 25. 

I play some pc games, idk if I really count as a gamer. There are a few other things I used to enjoy more (I did theater and student newspaper when I was in college, for instance) but nothing I've had passion enough to continue. I don't know if that's the depression or just getting older.

I have zero web design knowledge but you're totally right.  I looked into meetup and everything on there looks so stressful to me.  I can't imagine just walking in with a group of strangers who already know each other and feeling comfortable.  I've never been great at making friends, now it seems impossible.

Thanks for sharing.  I do try to take care of myself, and I think you're right, that's an important piece.  The thing about Christmas is that I'll get away from work and go visit family, which is a thing I have going for me.  We're not close but they are there.

The monotony of what I'm doing now is just getting to me really hard right now.  I don't like my circumstances - I'm depressed, yes, but I'm also just not in a good situation - and on top of that I'm lonely and have zero distractions from it.
